S1 admission.notes: The four Admitted equations match the English: Global always, Home and Session on sessionOverridable, Project on projectSettable.

R1 winner.notes: Over folds lowest first, so the highest live layer sets the shown token, and the premise is satisfiable.

R2 default.notes: With no live layer every Over returns the below value, which is the default from FromDefault.

R3 compose.notes: The Compose chain over live layers, lowest first, equals Folded over LiveTokens.

R4 untrusted-inert.notes: An unapplied layer feeds only Shown and Visible, and Over ignores non-applied shown values.

R5 higher-scope-wins.notes: For an ordinary setting the premise fixes every layer at rank l or above, so the highest live layer and its value do not change.

R6 shown.notes: ShownOf is Shown exactly when Visible, with the token, the qualified flag and the applied flag as stated.

R7 not-applied.notes: Top makes the highest visible layer decide, so an unapplied one is reported and the origin falls below it.

R8 below.notes: The Below PlainOver chain with its strictly-below flags equals BelowTokens folded over the default in rank order.
